name: Elephant-ear fish
summary: Cá tai tượng is elephant-ear fish, fried whole and served upright, then pulled apart and rolled in rice paper with pickles, cucumber, and herbs. It is a classic Mekong plate to order in Can Tho.
origin: The Mekong Delta, eaten in Can Tho and Châu Đốc.
howToEat: Pull the meat off the upright fish and roll it in rice paper with pickles, cucumber, and herbs.
where: Mekong restaurants in Can Tho and Châu Đốc.
seoDescription: Elephant-ear fish fried whole and rolled in rice paper with pickles, cucumber, and herbs, a classic Mekong plate.
